findings.title: Supabase session persisted in AsyncStorage instead of SecureStore/Keychain
findings.recommendation: Swap the auth.storage adapter to an ExpoSecureStore-backed shim (SecureStore has a 2KB value limit — chunk the JWT) so refresh tokens live in Keychain/Keystore.

findings.title: No biometric app-unlock (expo-local-authentication absent from package.json)
findings.recommendation: Add optional FaceID/TouchID gate on app foreground when a session exists.

findings.title: 9/201 source files declare accessibility props
findings.recommendation: Every icon-only TouchableOpacity and primary CTA needs accessibilityLabel/accessibilityRole; minimum touch target 44x44.
